CHANNEL.TITLE: WhatsApp Web (Unofficial)

CREATE.TITLE: WhatsApp Web (Unofficial)
CREATE.DESCRIPTION: Connect a WhatsApp number by scanning a QR code from your phone.

WARNING.TITLE: Unofficial integration — account ban risk
WARNING.BODY: This connects WhatsApp through an unofficial method (WhatsApp Web / Baileys). It is not supported by WhatsApp, can violate WhatsApp's Terms of Service, and may get the linked phone number permanently banned. For production use, we strongly recommend the official WhatsApp Business Platform instead.
WARNING.ACK: I understand the risks and accept that the linked WhatsApp number may be permanently banned.

QR.TITLE: Scan the QR code
QR.INSTRUCTIONS: Open WhatsApp on your phone → Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, then scan this code.

CONNECTED.TITLE: WhatsApp connected
CONNECTED.BODY: Your WhatsApp number is linked. You can now add agents and start handling conversations.

PANEL.TITLE: WhatsApp Web connection
PANEL.DESCRIPTION: Manage the unofficial WhatsApp Web link for this inbox.
PANEL.UNAVAILABLE: The WhatsApp Web connector is currently unavailable. Status and controls will resume when it is reachable.

LOGOUT_CONFIRM.TITLE: Log out this WhatsApp number?
LOGOUT_CONFIRM.BODY: This unlinks the WhatsApp number from the connector. The inbox is kept so you can scan a new QR code to pair again.
